text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,514.3, up 1.14% on the day, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.13%. Gains were broad‑based with 350 advances versus 143 declines, a breadth score of 71.9 indicating a “healthy” market. All major sectors in the leading quadrant – PSU banks, private banks, financial services, auto and FMCG – contributed, and the top gainers included VOLTAS, BLUESTARCO and MARUTI.  

Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹7,411 crore, whereas domestic institutional investors (DIIs) sold ₹1,357 crore, leaving a net inflow of about ₹6,054 crore. In futures, FIIs held a net short of 68,247 contracts but turned slightly more long this session (+2,423 contracts). Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.47 for Nifty and 1.36 for Bank Nifty, suggesting modest bearish sentiment, with max‑pain levels at 25,300 (Nifty) and 61,000 (Bank Nifty). Call walls sit at 26,000 and 64,000 respectively, while put walls are at 25,000 and 61,000.  

Watch the Nifty pivot zone: support at 25,241.3, pivot at 25,377.8 and resistance at 25,650.8. For Bank Nifty, key levels are 62,321.73 (S1), 62,692.37 (pivot) and 63,433.63 (R1). Next session could be influenced by USD‑INR at 93.28, Brent crude at $90.6 and global cues from US indices, which were all higher. Keep an eye on any news on FII buying trends or RBI rate actions that could shift momentum.
